intro: Professionals and everyday users convert stones (st) to pounds (lb) when working across imperial and imperial standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One stone (uk) equals 14 pounds, while 1 pound (avoirdupois) equals 0.071429 stones. Whether you are verifying mass & weight specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

faqs.question: How many pounds (lb) are in 1 stone (uk) (st)?
faqs.answer: There are 14 pounds (lb) in 1 stone (uk) (st), which rounds to 14 lb for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 pound (avoirdupois) equals 0.071429 stones.

faqs.question: How do I convert stones to pounds (st to lb)?
faqs.answer: To convert stones to pounds, use the formula: lb = st × 14. For example, converting 11 st gives 154 lb.

faqs.question: What is 11 stones in pounds?
faqs.answer: 11 stones (st) equals exactly 154 pounds (lb) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
